## Combo 2-198-1651-2499

Color identity: BGU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite colored mana; Infinite charge counters on a permanent; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite storm count
Start: Yarok, the Desecrated (battlefield); Ancestral Statue (hand); Clock of Omens (battlefield); Empowered Autogenerator (battlefield)

  You control a nontoken noncreature artifact with mana value less than or equal to the number of charge counters on Empowered Autogenerator minus three.
Steps: Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
  Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
  When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
  Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the nontoken noncreature artifact and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.

  Cast the noncreature artifact by paying its mana cost.
  Repeat.

  Repeat.

  When the land enters, each Scute Swarm triggers, creating that many creature tokens.
  Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
  Repeat.

Color identity: BGU | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {U}
Produces: Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers
Start: Genestealer Patriarch (battlefield); Leech Bonder (battlefield); Bloodflow Connoisseur (battlefield); Host of the Hereafter (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
  An opponent controls a creature.
  Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
  You control at least two additional creatures.
Steps: Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
  Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
  Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
  Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
  When the creature dies, Host of the Hereafter and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
  Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
  Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
  Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
  Repeat from step 4.
